new_failures.failed_witness: The first broad memory-registry query exceeded the model-visible output window.
new_failures.recovery: Used narrow task-relevant registry queries and retained only the canonical-latch and delivery-separation guidance.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Query the memory registry by the exact phase, owner, or lifecycle concept before widening scope.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first Git probe ran from the Codex configuration directory, which is not a Git worktree.
new_failures.recovery: Resolved the exact D-first Orin source worktree before any repository command.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Bind every Git probe to an explicit verified worktree path.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first 300-line activation-baton projection truncated before EOF.
new_failures.recovery: Measured the baton and read it in contiguous bounded windows through the final line.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Measure long activation packets before choosing a display window.

new_failures.failed_witness: A PowerShell foreach producer was piped directly and raised a parser error before any mutation.
new_failures.recovery: Materialized the reference inventory before applying any pipeline operation.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Never pipe directly from a PowerShell foreach statement.

new_failures.failed_witness: A grouped installed-skill reference projection truncated before all required files were attributable.
new_failures.recovery: Read each remaining skill and directly required reference by exact path through EOF.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Group only small reference files whose combined measured size fits the output bound.

new_failures.failed_witness: A 1,000-line Method Flow slice exceeded the model-visible context and truncated mid-ledger.
new_failures.recovery: Parsed the complete immutable ledger once and projected every array by exact keys, counts, identifiers, and invariant values.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use structured compact projections for repetitive ledgers after measuring their line and byte counts.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first compact Method Flow projection returned no attributable text despite a valid Git object.
new_failures.recovery: Separated object retrieval from JSON parsing, proved the 4,972-line object, then emitted explicit compact properties and witnesses.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Prove object retrieval and parser success separately before composing a dense projection.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first grouped owner-local skill read returned one marker and no skill body.
new_failures.recovery: Read all twenty immutable owner-local skills in exact smaller batches with visible bodies through EOF.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use explicit paths and bounded batches for repeated Git-object reads.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first source-script inventory pathspec returned no matching rows although exact manifest paths existed.
new_failures.recovery: Read the final owner manifest and resolved each script and test by its exact Git-object path.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use the phase manifest as the authoritative owner-path inventory.

new_failures.failed_witness: A second whole-tree regex inventory also returned no attributable owner-script rows.
new_failures.recovery: Used exact manifest-listed paths and direct Git-object reads instead of another broad inventory.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Do not widen a failed inventory projection before checking the exact owner manifest.

new_failures.failed_witness: A targeted overlay search guessed three nonexistent reference filenames and returned path errors.
new_failures.recovery: Inventoried the actual installed overlay filenames and read only those exact current files.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Resolve overlay filenames with a bounded file inventory before targeted content search.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first combined source-equality and collision preflight returned no attributable text.
new_failures.recovery: Separated local state and collision checks from the fresh-live remote read; both returned exact values before lane creation.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Keep slow worktree enumeration and live-remote reads in separately attributable probes.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first template seed attempted to copy into sparse parent directories that did not yet exist, so the copy and dependent rewrites failed without creating files.
new_failures.recovery: Created only the owner-lane scripts and tests directories, copied the two immutable templates, verified their lengths, and then applied the mechanical rename.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Materialize exact sparse parent directories before copying an owner-local template.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first combined syntax and stale-label wrapper returned no attributable output under nested shell quoting.
new_failures.recovery: Ran compilation and fixed-string stale-label projection as separate read-only checks; both returned attributable results.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Keep compilation and multi-pattern shell searches independently attributable.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first complete reachable proposal audit found one exact collision and three titles at or above the 0.78 token-Jaccard quarantine threshold.
new_failures.recovery: Projected the three exact neighbour pairs and refined only those titles while preserving hypotheses, dispositions, gates, and mutations.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Run the complete reachable semantic-neighbour audit before freeze and retain every quarantined first attempt.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first status-to-allowlist comparison treated Git's collapsed untracked directory row as an individual file list and produced false missing and unexpected counts.
new_failures.recovery: Enumerated untracked files with git ls-files --others --exclude-standard and combined them with tracked deltas before exact path comparison.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Expand untracked directories to files before comparing repository status with a file allowlist.

source_external_overlay_witnesses.failed_witness: The canonical command window yielded before its already-running process completed.
source_external_overlay_witnesses.recovery: Monitored the same process and exclusive receipt to completion without a second invocation.

source_external_overlay_witnesses.failed_witness: A broad successor reread matched generic historical stop-condition vocabulary and was unsuitable as a current pause decision.
source_external_overlay_witnesses.recovery: Inspected the documented turn structure and newest attributable completed state.

source_external_overlay_witnesses.failed_witness: An all-in-one skill-overlay patch was rejected before writing because a tail anchor differed.
source_external_overlay_witnesses.recovery: Split additive new-file creation from exact-tail entrypoint updates.
